name: Shortcut
description: Shortcut stories and sub-tasks in Orca: browse your work, start worktrees from sub-tasks and keep Shortcut in step.

settings.title: Default states
settings.description: Workflow states the list shows until you pick others in the panel, separated by commas. Names as in Shortcut, e.g. Ready, In Development (Sub-tasks).

settings.title: Default owner
settings.description: Whose stories the list shows until you pick another owner in the panel.

settings.title: Started sub-task state
settings.description: The workflow state a sub-task moves to when you start work on it. Never moves a sub-task back.

settings.title: Started story state
settings.description: The workflow state a story moves to when work starts on one of its sub-tasks, if it has not started yet.

settings.title: Work only on sub-tasks
settings.description: Start worktrees only from sub-tasks, never from the stories they belong to.

settings.title: Default agent
settings.description: The agent offered first when you start work.

settings.title: New sub-task state
settings.description: The workflow state a sub-task created from the panel starts in.

settings.title: Show ready count
settings.description: Show in the status bar how many sub-tasks the default states and owner list, such as your sub-tasks in Ready.
